views.name: student_attendance_summary
views.definition:
SELECT a.course AS courseid,
    al.studentid AS userid,
    a.id AS attendance_id,
    a.name AS attendance_name,
    count(DISTINCT s.id) AS total_sessions,
    count(al.id) AS marked_sessions,
    count(al.id) FILTER (WHERE ((st.acronym)::text = 'P'::text)) AS present_count,
    count(al.id) FILTER (WHERE ((st.acronym)::text = 'L'::text)) AS late_count,
    count(al.id) FILTER (WHERE ((st.acronym)::text = 'E'::text)) AS excused_count,
    count(al.id) FILTER (WHERE ((st.acronym)::text = 'A'::text)) AS absent_count,
    round(((sum(st.grade) / NULLIF(((count(al.id))::numeric * max_status.max_grade), (0)::numeric)) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS attendance_percentage
   FROM ((((lms.attendance a
     JOIN lms.attendance_sessions s ON ((s.attendanceid = a.id)))
     JOIN lms.attendance_log al ON ((al.sessionid = s.id)))
     JOIN lms.attendance_statuses st ON ((st.id = al.statusid)))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(st2.grade) AS max_grade
           FROM lms.attendance_statuses st2
          WHERE ((st2.attendanceid = a.id) AND (st2.deleted = 0) AND (st2.visible = 1))) max_status)
  GROUP BY a.course, al.studentid, a.id, a.name, max_status.max_grade;

WITH candidates AS (
         SELECT li.userid,
            li.courseid,
            li.course_name,
            li.section_id,
            li.section_number,
            li.section_name,
            li.coursemoduleid,
            li.activity_type,
            li.source_id,
            li.activity_name,
            li.due_time,
            li.completionstate,
            li.viewed,
            li.task_status,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY li.userid, li.courseid ORDER BY li.section_number, li.coursemoduleid) AS recommendation_rank
           FROM derived.student_course_learning_items li
          WHERE (((li.activity_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['resource'::character varying, 'folder'::character varying, 'assign'::character varying, 'quiz'::character varying])::text[])) AND (((li.completion_tracking <> 0) AND (li.completionstate <> ALL (ARRAY[1, 2, 3]))) OR ((li.completion_tracking = 0) AND ((li.activity_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['resource'::character varying, 'folder'::character varying])::text[])))) AND (((li.activity_type)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['assign'::character varying, 'quiz'::character varying])::text[])) OR (li.task_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'::text)))
        )
 SELECT userid,
    courseid,
    course_name,
    section_id,
    section_number,
    section_name,
    coursemoduleid,
    activity_type,
    source_id,
    activity_name,
    due_time,
    completionstate,
    viewed,
    task_status,
    'next_learning_item'::text AS recommendation_basis
   FROM candidates
  WHERE (recommendation_rank = 1);

views.name: student_course_learning_items
views.definition:
WITH student_courses AS (
         SELECT student_course_progress.userid,
            student_course_progress.courseid
           FROM derived.student_course_progress
        )
 SELECT sc.userid,
    cm.course AS courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    cs.id AS section_id,
    cs.section AS section_number,
    cs.name AS section_name,
    cm.id AS coursemoduleid,
    m.name AS activity_type,
    cm.instance AS source_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'assign'::text) THEN a.name
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'quiz'::text) THEN q.name
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'resource'::text) THEN res.name
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'folder'::text) THEN fol.name
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'forum'::text) THEN f.name
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'attendance'::text) THEN att.name
            ELSE cm.idnumber
        END AS activity_name,
        CASE
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'assign'::text) THEN a.duedate
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'quiz'::text) THEN q.timeclose
            ELSE NULL::bigint
        END AS due_time,
    cm.visible,
    cm.visibleoncoursepage,
    cm.completion AS completion_tracking,
    COALESCE((cmc.completionstate)::integer, 0) AS completionstate,
    cmc.viewed,
    ut.task_status,
    ut.source_status,
    ((('/mod/'::text || (m.name)::text) || '/view.php?id='::text) || (cm.id)::text) AS moodle_path
   FROM ((((((((((((student_courses sc
     JOIN lms.course_modules cm ON ((cm.course = sc.courseid)))
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = cm.course)))
     JOIN lms.modules m ON ((m.id = cm.module)))
     LEFT JOIN lms.course_sections cs ON ((cs.id = cm.section)))
     LEFT JOIN lms.assign a ON ((((m.name)::text = 'assign'::text) AND (a.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.quiz q ON ((((m.name)::text = 'quiz'::text) AND (q.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.resource res ON ((((m.name)::text = 'resource'::text) AND (res.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.folder fol ON ((((m.name)::text = 'folder'::text) AND (fol.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.forum f ON ((((m.name)::text = 'forum'::text) AND (f.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.attendance att ON ((((m.name)::text = 'attendance'::text) AND (att.id = cm.instance))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.course_modules_completion cmc ON (((cmc.coursemoduleid = cm.id) AND (cmc.userid = sc.userid))))
     LEFT JOIN derived.unified_tasks ut ON (((ut.userid = sc.userid) AND (ut.courseid = sc.courseid) AND ((ut.task_type)::text =
        CASE
            WHEN ((m.name)::text = 'assign'::text) THEN 'assignment'::text
            ELSE (m.name)::text
        END) AND (ut.source_id = cm.instance))))
  WHERE ((cm.deletioninprogress = 0) AND (cm.visible = 1) AND ((m.name)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('assign'::character varying)::text, ('quiz'::character varying)::text, ('resource'::character varying)::text, ('folder'::character varying)::text, ('forum'::character varying)::text, ('attendance'::character varying)::text])));

    p.courseid,

    COALESCE(t.total_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS total_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.completed_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS completed_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.pending_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS pending_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.overdue_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS overdue_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.upcoming_7_days, (0)::bigint) AS upcoming_7_days,

   FROM ((((derived.student_course_progress p

views.name: student_course_progress
views.definition:
WITH student_enrolments AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ue.userid,
            e.courseid
           FROM ((lms.user_enrolments ue
             JOIN lms.enrol e ON ((e.id = ue.enrolid)))
             JOIN lms.role r ON ((r.id = e.roleid)))
          WHERE ((ue.status = 0) AND (e.status = 0) AND (((r.shortname)::text = 'student'::text) OR ((r.archetype)::text = 'student'::text)))
        ), tracked_modules AS (
         SELECT cm_1.course AS courseid,
            count(*) AS total_tracked_activities
           FROM lms.course_modules cm_1
          WHERE ((cm_1.completion <> 0) AND (cm_1.deletioninprogress = 0) AND (cm_1.visible = 1))
          GROUP BY cm_1.course
        ), completed_modules AS (
         SELECT se_1.userid,
            se_1.courseid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (cmc.completionstate = ANY (ARRAY[1, 2, 3]))) AS completed_activities
           FROM ((student_enrolments se_1
             LEFT JOIN lms.course_modules cm_1 ON (((cm_1.course = se_1.courseid) AND (cm_1.completion <> 0) AND (cm_1.deletioninprogress = 0) AND (cm_1.visible = 1))))
             LEFT JOIN lms.course_modules_completion cmc ON (((cmc.coursemoduleid = cm_1.id) AND (cmc.userid = se_1.userid))))
          GROUP BY se_1.userid, se_1.courseid
        )
 SELECT se.userid,
    se.courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    c.shortname AS course_shortname,
    COALESCE(tm.total_tracked_activities, (0)::bigint) AS total_tracked_activities,
    COALESCE(cm.completed_activities, (0)::bigint) AS completed_activities,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(tm.total_tracked_activities, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE round((((COALESCE(cm.completed_activities, (0)::bigint))::numeric / (tm.total_tracked_activities)::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS progress_percentage,
    cc.timecompleted AS course_timecompleted,
        CASE
            WHEN (cc.timecompleted IS NOT NULL) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS course_completed
   FROM ((((student_enrolments se
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = se.courseid)))
     LEFT JOIN tracked_modules tm ON ((tm.courseid = se.courseid)))
     LEFT JOIN completed_modules cm ON (((cm.userid = se.userid) AND (cm.courseid = se.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.course_completions cc ON (((cc.userid = se.userid) AND (cc.course = se.courseid))));

views.name: student_dashboard
views.definition:
WITH progress_summary AS (
         SELECT student_course_progress.userid,
            count(*) AS course_count,
            round(avg(student_course_progress.progress_percentage), 2) AS average_progress,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (student_course_progress.course_completed = true)) AS completed_courses
           FROM derived.student_course_progress
          GROUP BY student_course_progress.userid
        ), task_summary AS (
         SELECT student_task_summary.userid,
            sum(student_task_summary.pending_tasks) AS pending_tasks,
            sum(student_task_summary.overdue_tasks) AS overdue_tasks,
            sum(student_task_summary.upcoming_7_days) AS upcoming_7_days
           FROM derived.student_task_summary
          GROUP BY student_task_summary.userid
        ), notification_summary AS (
         SELECT notifications.user_id AS userid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (notifications.is_read = false)) AS unread_notifications
           FROM app.notifications
          GROUP BY notifications.user_id
        ), goal_summary AS (
         SELECT learning_goals.user_id AS userid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((learning_goals.status)::text = 'active'::text)) AS active_goals
           FROM app.learning_goals
          GROUP BY learning_goals.user_id
        ), attendance_summary AS (
         SELECT student_attendance_summary.userid,
            round(avg(student_attendance_summary.attendance_percentage), 2) AS average_attendance
           FROM derived.student_attendance_summary
          GROUP BY student_attendance_summary.userid
        )
 SELECT u.id AS userid,
    u.username,
    u.firstname,
    u.lastname,
    u.email,
    COALESCE(ps.course_count, (0)::bigint) AS course_count,
    COALESCE(ps.completed_courses, (0)::bigint) AS completed_courses,
    COALESCE(ps.average_progress, (0)::numeric) AS average_progress,
    COALESCE(ts.pending_tasks, (0)::numeric) AS pending_tasks,
    COALESCE(ts.overdue_tasks, (0)::numeric) AS overdue_tasks,
    COALESCE(ts.upcoming_7_days, (0)::numeric) AS upcoming_7_days,
    COALESCE(ns.unread_notifications, (0)::bigint) AS unread_notifications,
    COALESCE(gs.active_goals, (0)::bigint) AS active_goals,
    ats.average_attendance
   FROM (((((lms."user" u
     JOIN progress_summary ps ON ((ps.userid = u.id)))
     LEFT JOIN task_summary ts ON ((ts.userid = u.id)))
     LEFT JOIN notification_summary ns ON ((ns.userid = u.id)))
     LEFT JOIN goal_summary gs ON ((gs.userid = u.id)))
     LEFT JOIN attendance_summary ats ON ((ats.userid = u.id)))
  WHERE ((u.deleted = 0) AND (u.suspended = 0));

views.name: student_engagement
views.definition:
WITH student_enrolments AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ue.userid,
            e.courseid
           FROM ((lms.user_enrolments ue
             JOIN lms.enrol e ON ((e.id = ue.enrolid)))
             JOIN lms.role r ON ((r.id = e.roleid)))
          WHERE ((ue.status = 0) AND (e.status = 0) AND (((r.shortname)::text = 'student'::text) OR ((r.archetype)::text = 'student'::text)))
        )
 SELECT se.userid,
    se.courseid,
    ula.timeaccess AS last_course_access,
    max(l.timecreated) AS last_log_activity,
    count(l.id) FILTER (WHERE (l.timecreated >= ((EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint - 604800))) AS events_last_7_days,
    count(DISTINCT date(to_timestamp((l.timecreated)::double precision))) FILTER (WHERE (l.timecreated >= ((EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint - 604800))) AS active_days_last_7_days,
        CASE
            WHEN (max(l.timecreated) IS NOT NULL) THEN (floor(((((EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint - max(l.timecreated)))::numeric / 86400.0)))::integer
            WHEN (ula.timeaccess > 0) THEN (floor(((((EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint - ula.timeaccess))::numeric / 86400.0)))::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS days_since_last_activity
   FROM ((student_enrolments se
     LEFT JOIN lms.user_lastaccess ula ON (((ula.userid = se.userid) AND (ula.courseid = se.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN lms.logstore_standard_log l ON (((l.userid = se.userid) AND (l.courseid = se.courseid) AND (l.anonymous = 0))))
  GROUP BY se.userid, se.courseid, ula.timeaccess;

views.name: student_grade_category_summary
views.definition:
WITH item_grades AS (
         SELECT gg.userid,
            gi.courseid,
            gc.id AS category_id,
            gc.fullname AS category_name,
            parent.id AS parent_category_id,
            parent.fullname AS parent_category_name,
            gi.id AS grade_item_id,
            gi.itemmodule,
            gi.itemname,
            gg.finalgrade,
            gi.grademin,
            gi.grademax,
            gi.gradepass,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((gg.finalgrade IS NULL) OR (gi.grademax IS NULL) OR (gi.grademax = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE ((gg.finalgrade / gi.grademax) * (100)::numeric)
                END AS percentage
           FROM (((lms.grade_grades gg
             JOIN lms.grade_items gi ON ((gi.id = gg.itemid)))
             LEFT JOIN lms.grade_categories gc ON ((gc.id = gi.categoryid)))
             LEFT JOIN lms.grade_categories parent ON ((parent.id = gc.parent)))
          WHERE ((gi.itemtype)::text = 'mod'::text)
        )
 SELECT ig.userid,
    ig.courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    ig.category_id,
    ig.category_name,
    ig.parent_category_id,
    ig.parent_category_name,
    count(*) AS grade_item_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ig.finalgrade IS NOT NULL)) AS graded_item_count,
    round(avg(ig.percentage), 2) AS category_average_percentage,
    min(ig.percentage) AS minimum_percentage,
    max(ig.percentage) AS maximum_percentage
   FROM (item_grades ig
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = ig.courseid)))
  GROUP BY ig.userid, ig.courseid, c.fullname, ig.category_id, ig.category_name, ig.parent_category_id, ig.parent_category_name;

views.name: student_grade_overview
views.definition:
SELECT gg.userid,
    gi.courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    c.shortname AS course_shortname,
    gi.id AS grade_item_id,
    gi.itemmodule AS activity_type,
    gi.iteminstance AS source_id,
    gi.itemname AS activity_name,
    gg.rawgrade,
    gg.finalgrade,
    gi.grademin,
    gi.grademax,
    gi.gradepass,
        CASE
            WHEN (gg.finalgrade IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            WHEN ((gi.grademax IS NULL) OR (gi.grademax = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(((gg.finalgrade / gi.grademax) * (100)::numeric), 2)
        END AS grade_percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN (gg.finalgrade IS NULL) THEN NULL::boolean
            WHEN ((gi.gradepass IS NULL) OR (gi.gradepass = (0)::numeric)) THEN NULL::boolean
            WHEN (gg.finalgrade >= gi.gradepass) THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS passed,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN ((gi.grademax > (0)::numeric) AND (gg.finalgrade IS NOT NULL)) THEN ((gg.finalgrade / gi.grademax) * (100)::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY gg.userid, gi.courseid), 2) AS course_average_percentage,
    gg.feedback,
    gg.timemodified,
    gc.id AS category_id,
    gc.fullname AS category_name,
    parent.id AS parent_category_id,
    parent.fullname AS parent_category_name
   FROM ((((lms.grade_grades gg
     JOIN lms.grade_items gi ON ((gi.id = gg.itemid)))
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = gi.courseid)))
     LEFT JOIN lms.grade_categories gc ON ((gc.id = gi.categoryid)))
     LEFT JOIN lms.grade_categories parent ON ((parent.id = gc.parent)))
  WHERE ((gi.itemtype)::text = 'mod'::text);

views.name: student_learning_analytics
views.definition:
WITH grade_summary AS (

            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (student_grade_overview.finalgrade IS NOT NULL)) AS graded_items
           FROM derived.student_grade_overview
          GROUP BY student_grade_overview.userid, student_grade_overview.courseid
        )
 SELECT p.userid,
    p.courseid,
    p.course_name,
    p.progress_percentage,
    COALESCE(t.total_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS total_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.completed_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS completed_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.pending_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS pending_tasks,
    COALESCE(t.overdue_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS overdue_tasks,
    COALESCE(e.events_last_7_days, (0)::bigint) AS events_last_7_days,
    COALESCE(e.active_days_last_7_days, (0)::bigint) AS active_days_last_7_days,
    e.days_since_last_activity,
    gs.average_grade_percentage,
    COALESCE(gs.graded_items, (0)::bigint) AS graded_items,
    att.attendance_percentage,
    COALESCE(att.total_sessions, (0)::bigint) AS attendance_sessions,
    COALESCE(att.present_count, (0)::bigint) AS present_count,
    COALESCE(att.late_count, (0)::bigint) AS late_count,
    COALESCE(att.absent_count, (0)::bigint) AS absent_count,
    r.risk_score,
    r.risk_level
   FROM (((((derived.student_course_progress p
     LEFT JOIN derived.student_task_summary t ON (((t.userid = p.userid) AND (t.courseid = p.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN derived.student_engagement e ON (((e.userid = p.userid) AND (e.courseid = p.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN grade_summary gs ON (((gs.userid = p.userid) AND (gs.courseid = p.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN derived.student_attendance_summary att ON (((att.userid = p.userid) AND (att.courseid = p.courseid))))
     LEFT JOIN derived.student_risk_indicator r ON (((r.userid = p.userid) AND (r.courseid = p.courseid))));

views.name: student_risk_indicator
views.definition:
WITH risk_base AS (
         SELECT p.userid,
            p.courseid,
            p.course_name,
            p.progress_percentage,
            COALESCE(t.pending_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS pending_tasks,
            COALESCE(t.overdue_tasks, (0)::bigint) AS overdue_tasks,
            COALESCE(e.events_last_7_days, (0)::bigint) AS events_last_7_days,
            e.active_days_last_7_days,
            e.days_since_last_activity,
            LEAST(100, (((
                CASE
                    WHEN (e.days_since_last_activity >= 14) THEN 40
                    WHEN (e.days_since_last_activity >= 7) THEN 25
                    ELSE 0
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(t.overdue_tasks, (0)::bigint) >= 3) THEN 30
                    WHEN (COALESCE(t.overdue_tasks, (0)::bigint) >= 1) THEN 15
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE
                    WHEN ((p.total_tracked_activities > 0) AND (p.progress_percentage < (30)::numeric)) THEN 25
                    WHEN ((p.total_tracked_activities > 0) AND (p.progress_percentage < (60)::numeric)) THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END) +
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(e.events_last_7_days, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN 10
                    ELSE 0
                END)) AS risk_score
           FROM ((derived.student_course_progress p
             LEFT JOIN derived.student_task_summary t ON (((t.userid = p.userid) AND (t.courseid = p.courseid))))
             LEFT JOIN derived.student_engagement e ON (((e.userid = p.userid) AND (e.courseid = p.courseid))))
        )
 SELECT userid,
    courseid,
    course_name,
    progress_percentage,
    pending_tasks,
    overdue_tasks,
    events_last_7_days,
    active_days_last_7_days,
    days_since_last_activity,
    risk_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (risk_score >= 60) THEN 'HIGH'::text
            WHEN (risk_score >= 30) THEN 'MEDIUM'::text
            ELSE 'LOW'::text
        END AS risk_level
   FROM risk_base;

views.name: teacher_course_overview
views.definition:
WITH teacher_courses AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ra.userid AS teacherid,
            ctx.instanceid AS courseid
           FROM ((lms.role_assignments ra
             JOIN lms.role r ON ((r.id = ra.roleid)))
             JOIN lms.context ctx ON ((ctx.id = ra.contextid)))
          WHERE ((ctx.contextlevel = 50) AND (((r.shortname)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('teacher'::character varying)::text, ('editingteacher'::character varying)::text])) OR ((r.archetype)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('teacher'::character varying)::text, ('editingteacher'::character varying)::text]))))
        ), student_metrics AS (
         SELECT student_course_progress.courseid,
            count(DISTINCT student_course_progress.userid) AS student_count,
            round(avg(student_course_progress.progress_percentage), 2) AS average_progress
           FROM derived.student_course_progress
          GROUP BY student_course_progress.courseid
        ), risk_metrics AS (
         SELECT student_risk_indicator.courseid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (student_risk_indicator.risk_level = 'HIGH'::text)) AS high_risk_students,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (student_risk_indicator.risk_level = 'MEDIUM'::text)) AS medium_risk_students,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (student_risk_indicator.risk_level = ANY (ARRAY['MEDIUM'::text, 'HIGH'::text]))) AS students_need_attention
           FROM derived.student_risk_indicator
          GROUP BY student_risk_indicator.courseid
        ), deadline_source AS (
         SELECT assign.course AS courseid,
            assign.duedate AS deadline
           FROM lms.assign
          WHERE (assign.duedate > 0)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT quiz.course AS courseid,
            quiz.timeclose AS deadline
           FROM lms.quiz
          WHERE (quiz.timeclose > 0)
        ), deadline_metrics AS (
         SELECT deadline_source.courseid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((deadline_source.deadline >= (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint) AND (deadline_source.deadline <= ((EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint + 604800)))) AS upcoming_deadlines_7_days
           FROM deadline_source
          GROUP BY deadline_source.courseid
        ), latest_submissions AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (assign_submission.assignment, assign_submission.userid) assign_submission.assignment,
            assign_submission.userid,
            assign_submission.status,
            assign_submission.attemptnumber,
            assign_submission.latest,
            assign_submission.timemodified
           FROM lms.assign_submission
          ORDER BY assign_submission.assignment, assign_submission.userid, assign_submission.latest DESC, assign_submission.attemptnumber DESC, assign_submission.timemodified DESC
        ), grading_metrics AS (
         SELECT a.course AS courseid,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (((ls.status)::text = 'submitted'::text) AND ((ag.id IS NULL) OR (ag.grade IS NULL)))) AS needs_grading_count
           FROM ((latest_submissions ls
             JOIN lms.assign a ON ((a.id = ls.assignment)))
             LEFT JOIN lms.assign_grades ag ON (((ag.assignment = ls.assignment) AND (ag.userid = ls.userid) AND (ag.attemptnumber = ls.attemptnumber))))
          GROUP BY a.course
        )
 SELECT c.id AS courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    c.shortname AS course_shortname,
    COALESCE(sm.student_count, (0)::bigint) AS student_count,
    COALESCE(sm.average_progress, (0)::numeric) AS average_progress,
    COALESCE(rm.high_risk_students, (0)::bigint) AS high_risk_students,
    COALESCE(rm.medium_risk_students, (0)::bigint) AS medium_risk_students,
    COALESCE(rm.students_need_attention, (0)::bigint) AS students_need_attention,
    COALESCE(dm.upcoming_deadlines_7_days, (0)::bigint) AS upcoming_deadlines_7_days,
    COALESCE(gm.needs_grading_count, (0)::bigint) AS needs_grading_count,
    tc.teacherid
   FROM (((((teacher_courses tc
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = tc.courseid)))
     LEFT JOIN student_metrics sm ON ((sm.courseid = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN risk_metrics rm ON ((rm.courseid = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN deadline_metrics dm ON ((dm.courseid = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN grading_metrics gm ON ((gm.courseid = c.id)));

          WHERE ((ue.status = 0) AND (e.status = 0) AND (((r.shortname)::text = 'student'::text) OR ((r.archetype)::text = 'student'::text)))
        ), latest_assignment_submission AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (assign_submission.assignment, assign_submission.userid) assign_submission.id,
            assign_submission.assignment,
            assign_submission.userid,
            assign_submission.status,
            assign_submission.attemptnumber,
            assign_submission.latest,
            assign_submission.timecreated,
            assign_submission.timemodified
           FROM lms.assign_submission
          ORDER BY assign_submission.assignment, assign_submission.userid, assign_submission.latest DESC, assign_submission.attemptnumber DESC, assign_submission.timemodified DESC
        ), latest_quiz_attempt AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (quiz_attempts.quiz, quiz_attempts.userid) quiz_attempts.id,
            quiz_attempts.quiz,
            quiz_attempts.userid,
            quiz_attempts.attempt,
            quiz_attempts.state,
            quiz_attempts.timestart,
            quiz_attempts.timefinish,
            quiz_attempts.timemodified,
            quiz_attempts.sumgrades
           FROM lms.quiz_attempts
          ORDER BY quiz_attempts.quiz, quiz_attempts.userid, quiz_attempts.attempt DESC, quiz_attempts.timemodified DESC
        )
 SELECT se.userid,
    a.course AS courseid,
    c.fullname AS course_name,
    'assignment'::character varying AS task_type,
    a.id AS source_id,
    a.name AS title,
    a.duedate AS due_time,
        CASE

            WHEN ((a.duedate > 0) AND (a.duedate < (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            ELSE 'pending'::text
        END AS task_status,
    las.status AS source_status,

    NULL::integer AS quiz_attempt,
    NULL::character varying AS quiz_state
   FROM (((student_enrolments se
     JOIN lms.assign a ON ((a.course = se.courseid)))
     JOIN lms.course c ON ((c.id = a.course)))
     LEFT JOIN latest_assignment_submission las ON (((las.assignment = a.id) AND (las.userid = se.userid))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT se.userid,

    c.fullname AS course_name,
    'quiz'::character varying AS task_type,
    q.id AS source_id,
    q.name AS title,
    q.timeclose AS due_time,
        CASE
            WHEN ((lqa.state)::text = 'finished'::text) THEN 'completed'::text
            WHEN ((q.timeclose > 0) AND (q.timeclose < (EXTRACT(epoch FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::bigint)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            ELSE 'pending'::text
        END AS task_status,
